compensating.why: hop 4 skips a tree that is itself a function
hop 3 skips a tree that contains a function
hop 2 leaves the map empty for a tree that is itself a function

context_edits.old: /** Returns the length of the text buffer. */

ownership_reason: Only the gold walks the tree and decides, node by node, where to descend; hop 2 creates the insertion-ordered map, hop 1 returns its values, hops 3 and 4 pass the root and the map along. Once the walk has entered a function, the names recorded there cannot be told apart from the tree's own by any caller, and keeping the walk out of every function at any depth takes a traversal with a function test, that is, a second implementation. The convention is pinned outside the gold: the facade's own javadoc ('excluding descent scopes'); NodeUtil.redeclareVarsInsideBranch, its production caller ('all the VAR declarations in that tree that are not in an inner scope'); SyntacticScopeCreator.scanVars, whose FUNCTION case returns ('should not examine function's children') and whose VAR case declares the names and returns, with SyntacticScopeCreatorTest.testFunctionScope ('[function bar2() { var y; }]': y is not declared in the outer scope); NodeUtil.containsTypeInOuterScope ('Does not traverse into functions'). FoldConstantsTest.testVarLifting lifts only a from 'if(false)var a=function(){var b};' and UnreachableCodeEliminationTest.testRemovalRequiresRedeclaration exercises the production caller; both pass on the variant. A var statement declares a variable of the function in whose body it stands, so 'function(){var foo;}' declares no variable of the tree, which the gold's contract ('the variables that a node tree declares with its var statements') then violates. A one-line edit at hop 4 that applies the gold to the root's children and skips the children that are functions (keeping a VAR root whole) passes the existing tests, but only because the trigger's function is a direct child of the root: a function one level deeper is still entered (parse("if(x){(function(){var y})()}") gives {y}) and a FUNCTION root then yields its own body's variables, contradicting the facade's 'excluding descent scopes' and every hop's documented result.
